auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in with your Geem account. Workspace membership does not grant Platform Admin access.
auth.logoutConfirmHint: You will need to sign in again to use Geem Admin.
auth.logoutAllConfirmHint: This ends every active session for your account.
auth.accessRequiredBody: This account is signed in but is not a Platform Admin. Workspace Owner or Administrator roles do not grant access here.
auth.brandHeadline: Operate Geem from a dedicated admin surface.
auth.brandBody: Manage the platform independently of any Workspace. Tenant membership never becomes Platform Admin access.
auth.highlightHostBody: Geem Admin lives on its own host. It is not a tenant application.
auth.highlightRoleBody: Access requires a Platform Admin account. Workspace roles cannot grant this.
auth.highlightAuditBody: High-impact mutations in later phases write to the existing audit log.

overview.title: Overview
overview.context: You are in Platform Admin. This surface is independent of Workspace membership and tenant RBAC.

placeholder.title: {{section}}
placeholder.body: This section is reserved for a later Phase 12 slice. No management APIs are available here yet.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email before signing in.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this resource.
errors.validation: Check the form and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.platformAdminHostRequired: This API is only available on the Platform Admin host.
errors.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.entitlementInvalid: One or more entitlement values are invalid.
errors.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Global inventory of Geem Workspaces. Default list shows tenant Workspaces.
workspaces.listDescription: Search and inspect tenant and system workspaces across the platform.
workspaces.tenantFilterHint: Tenant workspaces are shown by default. System workspaces are opt-in.
workspaces.customFilterHint: The directory reflects your current search and lifecycle filters.
workspaces.profileDescription: Identity, ownership, and lifecycle metadata for this workspace.
workspaces.membersDescription: Read-only membership directory and role assignments.
workspaces.subscriptionDescription: Current Workspace Geem plan and billing period.
workspaces.noSubscriptionHint: This tenant does not currently have an active Workspace plan.
workspaces.systemNotBillableHint: System workspaces are platform infrastructure and are not commercially billed.
workspaces.storageDescription: Current tenant storage against its resolved quota.
workspaces.storageUnavailable: Storage usage is not available for this workspace.
workspaces.noMembersHint: No Workspace memberships have been created.
workspaces.accessDescription: How the platform currently treats requests for this workspace.
workspaces.accessActiveHint: Members, API keys, widgets, and connected channels can use Geem subject to their own permissions.
workspaces.accessSuspendedHint: Members, API keys, Chat Widget messages, and connector webhooks are blocked until this workspace is enabled.
workspaces.accessSystemHint: This workspace supports platform operations and cannot be disabled from tenant lifecycle controls.
workspaces.disableHint: Disabling prevents its users, API keys, and connected channels from using Geem until the Workspace is enabled again.
workspaces.enableHint: Re-enabling restores normal access. It does not reset subscriptions, credits, or data.
workspaces.systemProtected: System Workspaces are protected and cannot be disabled here.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Monitor every Geem account, its platform access, and its Workspace footprint.
users.listDescription: Search accounts and inspect their access, activity, and Workspace memberships.
users.filterHint: All accounts are shown. Narrow the directory by lifecycle state or platform role.
users.customFilterHint: The directory reflects your current search and access filters.
users.membershipsDescription: Read-only view of the Workspaces and roles assigned to this account.
users.accessActiveHint: Sign-in is allowed. Workspace access still follows each Workspace's state and the user's role.
users.accessDisabledHint: Sign-in is blocked and existing sessions are revoked until the account is enabled.
users.disableHint: Disabling revokes active sessions and blocks sign-in until the account is enabled again.
users.enableHint: Re-enabling allows the user to sign in again. Existing Workspace memberships are unchanged.
users.selfProtected: You cannot disable your own Platform Admin account from this screen.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Manage Geem Workspace subscription plans and entitlements.
plans.listDescription: Review pricing, lifecycle state, adoption, and entitlement coverage.
plans.customFilterHint: Results reflect your search and status filters.
plans.summaryErrorTitle: Plan inventory could not be summarized
plans.summaryErrorHint: The catalog is still available below. Retry to refresh inventory totals.
plans.createHint: Define commercial or internal plans using the entitlement catalog. Limits are keyed, not hardcoded by plan name.
plans.bootstrapProtected: Bootstrap plans cannot be deactivated from Platform Admin.
plans.name: Name
plans.activateHint: Active plans can be assigned to Workspaces and shown for commercial checkout when priced.
plans.deactivateHint: Archived plans cannot be newly assigned. Existing subscribers keep their subscription until changed.
plans.entitlementRequired: Fill every entitlement value from the catalog.
plans.entitlementInvalidValue: Entitlement values must be non-negative integers.
plans.storageInvalid: Storage must be a valid non-negative number of gigabytes.
plans.reasonInUse: Reason (required when changing entitlements on an in-use plan)
plans.reasonInUseHint: This plan has active subscribers. Explain why entitlements are changing.
plans.reasonRequiredInUse: A reason is required when changing entitlements on an in-use plan.

credits.title: Credits
credits.subtitle: Inspect Workspace credit balances and grant platform credits.
credits.workspaceListDescription: Select a tenant account to inspect or fund.
credits.workspaceFilterHint: Showing tenant Workspaces across all lifecycle states.
credits.customFilterHint: Results reflect your search and status filters.
credits.accountDescription: Select a Workspace to open its credit account and append-only ledger.
credits.pickHint: Search and select a Workspace to view credits.
credits.historyDescription: Every visible grant, consumption, adjustment, and expiry event.
credits.historyErrorTitle: Ledger history could not be loaded
credits.grantHint: Enter a positive whole-credit amount and an operational reason for {{workspace}}. A confirmation step follows.
credits.grantConfirmHint: Grant {{amount}} credits to {{workspace}}. This writes an append-only ledger entry.
credits.amountHint: Use a positive whole number. Credit grants cannot be negative.
credits.amountInvalid: Enter a positive whole number within the safe supported range.

billing.title: Billing
billing.systemNotBillable: System Workspaces are not billable. Subscription and credit mutations are blocked.
billing.entitlementsDescription: Effective limits inherited from the Workspace's current plan.
billing.assignHint: Manually assign a Geem Workspace plan. Usage counters and stored data are not reset.
billing.noUsageReset: Note: assigning a plan does not reset usage meters, credits, or Workspace data.
